scale.note: Scored critically: 3 means meets, 4 is strong, 5 is kept for areas where the candidate is exceptional.

criteria.label: Functional expertise
criteria.description: Depth in the function this role leads. 3: has led this function at a comparable level. 5: recognized as a top operator in it, with methods others copy.

criteria.label: Scale and scope
criteria.description: Size of what they have run (team, budget, P&L, revenue, territory) compared with this role. 3: has run roughly the scope the role requires. 5: has run clearly larger scope and could grow into the next stage.

criteria.label: Track record of results
criteria.description: Specific, recent outcomes they drove, not responsibilities they held. 3: at least one clear, quantified result in a recent role. 5: a repeated pattern of quantified results across roles.

criteria.label: Leadership and team building
criteria.description: Hiring, developing and keeping strong people. 3: has built or rebuilt a team at the level this role needs. 5: has developed leaders who went on to bigger roles, or built a team from scratch through a growth phase.

criteria.label: Stage and context fit
criteria.description: Experience in a company like this one: size, ownership (founder, venture, private equity, public), growth phase and pace. 3: has worked in a similar context. 5: has succeeded in this exact context, ideally more than once.

criteria.label: Industry and market knowledge
criteria.description: Knowledge of the sector, customers, buyers and regulation this role faces. 3: adjacent sector with transferable knowledge. 5: deep, current knowledge of this exact market and its key players.

criteria.label: Strategic judgment
criteria.description: Evidence of setting direction, making trade-offs and changing course when needed, shown in the record or the notes. 3: has owned a plan and its outcome. 5: has shaped company strategy beyond their own function.

criteria.label: Executive presence and communication
criteria.description: How clearly they communicate with senior stakeholders, boards and clients, as shown in conversation notes and their own materials. 3: clear and credible. 5: notes show they were compelling and persuasive at board or CEO level.

criteria.label: Motivation and availability
criteria.description: A credible, job-related reason to consider this move now, and fit with the role's timing, location and travel as stated in the job. 3: open to the move with no blocking constraint. 5: actively motivated by this specific role and available on the client's timeline.

recommendation.meaning: yes: worth a recruiter conversation for this search. no: not for this search.
